newsitem.title: UK: Shell gains on ADR strength and firm crude.
newsitem.headline: Shell gains on ADR strength and firm crude.

text.p: Shares in Shell Transport and Trading Co Plc climbed on Friday as firmer crude prices and a solid performance by its ADRs in New York dragged the shares higher, dealers said.
Shell's shares gained 11-1/2p to 1119p GMT after its ADRs rose $1-1/4 to $108-3/8 in New York and Brent crude dated firmed 14 cents in London trade.
In a strong oil sector, shares in British Petroleum Plc rose 6p to 730-1/2p by 0901 GMT as the ADRs finished $1-1/2 higher at $142-1/2.
Jurgen Lunshof, oil analyst at Credit Lyonnais Laing, believes that last months weakness in BP and Shell shares was overdone.
"There was panic selling which was overly bearish," Lunshof said.
"I think the oil majors will generate earnings growth ahead of the market average with BP providing superior earnings growth to Shell."
Elsewhere in the sector, Enterprise Plc advanced 7-1/2p to 628-1/2p and Lasmo Plc gained 1p to 234-1/p.
